title: Verifier: authenticate selected invoice references before portable comparison
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Verifier engineering / source-bound tooling, not mathematical admission. No new supplier, paid profile, physical claim or κ.**

This closes PR #2040's explicit invoice-reference handoff with an opt-in comparison of three selected PR1094 generated artifacts: `global/audit/PREFIX-AND-INVOICE.json`, `ADMISSION-CONTROLS.json`, and `ASSEMBLY.json`.

The source-bound census of all **105** reviewed strict outputs finds exactly two literal invoice digest references, both `input_sha256/fresh_invoice`. A format-only invoice transformation changes its raw SHA-256, so PR1824's retained comparator flags both freshly updated references. The new comparator authenticates **both raw links on each side before normalization**, then compares the **complete canonical invoice bytes and complete rebound consumer bytes**. Every other field, including other digests, remains exact. No global hash, timing or path exemption is introduced.

Evidence: **3,041 tree nodes retained; seven format positives; 6,076 nonroot omission/replacement cases, including 5,296 changed invoices with BOTH raw links consistently updated; 57 additional controls; 6,133 total rejections.** An independent typed-tree oracle represents edges as role tuples rather than reusing the primary serializer/digest.

Critical proof step: matching raw references alone never establishes payload equivalence. The complete canonical invoice itself is byte-compared; synchronized semantic mutation cannot be concealed by repairing its raw edges. For equal invoices, authenticate-then-rebind changes only the two representation-dependent edge values; full consumer comparison checks every other field.

Only nine new package files under `research/selected-invoice-reference-rebinding/`. No frozen caller, source archive, shared index, or selected pointer changes. This is a reusable subgraph predicate, **not full-output equivalence, a production false-acceptance claim, or a supplier replay**. PR2040's Linux observation is credited, not presented as a Linux run performed here.

## Task and overlap

- Base: `e112d71c8d7bb32435debcc54df932593dd8223a`.
- Commit: `323703a83640f4c104469bf29db18d7d579cb587`.
- Independent one-shot chooser: `a2e5a793b5e1a2555a2466367171c2ea`, verifier-engineering; complete cards in `SELECTION.json`.
- Task: `portable-replay`, scope **refined** to `selected1094/invoice-two-consumer/raw-authentication-before-typed-rebinding`; TASK written before substantial computation.
- [PR2040](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2040), `d31c1418c0c23994d1444dbd9d356b9a8238fd5e`: typed/path comparator audit, explicitly leaves this raw-reference handoff open. No pending code dependency.
- [PR1824](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1824), `ad5b1248f25a71983b20617e2f3a80be22f03990`: retained before comparator, merged at its pinned head.
- Selected source [PR1094](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1094), `0fc329d0bec93ca7cd288eaea1295172e8789810`: authenticated reviewed archive and committed certificate.
- Earlier `selected-generated-identity-audit` covers seven **different local artifacts**, not invoice consumers. `pr695-digest-audit`'s warning about whole-file hash substitution motivates synchronized semantic negatives here; its unavailable historical CI payloads are not claimed resolved.
- [Scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2049#discussioncomment-18931179).

Shared snapshot: 329 open PRs including drafts and 692 discussions including comments/replies, complete pagination on 2026-10-14 at 18:11/18:12Z. Local/merged predecessors, exact `rebinding` query and targeted live PR heads checked again before submission. No-match is not novelty; later changes may be absent from the cache.

## Validation

CPython **3.12.12**, macOS arm64, standard library. Observed final serial batch: **31.45 seconds** including launchers.

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -B research/selected-invoice-reference-rebinding/verify.py
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -O -B research/selected-invoice-reference-rebinding/test_compare.py
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-invoice-reference-rebinding --check-only
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-invoice-reference-rebinding
```

Observed: direct audit PASS; **8 focused tests OK**; metadata/source pins PASS; registered replay repeats audit and tests and ends `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/selected-invoice-reference-rebinding outcome=completed`.

```text
PASS_SELECTED_INVOICE_REFERENCE_REBINDING files=105 nodes=3041 edges=2 positives=7 field_mutations=6076 synchronized_invoice_mutations=5296 negatives=6133 no_new_kappa
```

Controls include one/both stale links, identical malformed graphs (no byte shortcut), misbound owner-audit references, duplicate keys, unsupported decimal/nonfinite numbers, complete list/shape/type retention, all27 Boolean-to-integer substitutions, CLI exit statuses, and an immutable gzip-header mutation that leaves the decompressed tar equal but **must fail the raw source pin**. RESULT records deterministic census and mutation transcript hashes.

Not run/claimed: full cold supplier replay, Linux/Windows, selected adoption, remote CI, formal kernel acceptance, or inherited all-size/compiler/hosting/precision/analytic discharge. Exact integer JSON grammar is deliberate; decimal/exponent number tokens fail closed rather than use binary64. Source/reference authenticity is distinct from mathematical truth.

New work Apache-2.0; source notices and frozen bytes unchanged. Prepared for @adamgall with **substantial OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 Astra) assistance** in design, implementation, experiments, tests and writing. No independent human review claimed.

## Open next questions

See package README/TASK. A future caller can compose this exact three-node predicate with a separately reviewed full-output comparator and explicit per-field time/path policy. This would remove the demonstrated invoice/reference portability obstruction without dropping coverage. The next step is the complete caller replay; adoption/source-pin review requires a maintainer decision. The rest of the graph is not certified by this package.
